name: Lars
self_text: Hi! I'm Lars, a non-binary Mexican in my mid 20s. When I'm not spending time on my woodworking projects, I love getting out with my Fuji camera. Honestly, I'm just looking for a relaxed photo walk. Fair warning, gear talk is fine but not the point is my thing. As for editing, I'm happy to teach post-processing. Most weeks I can do Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I'm searching for a photography partner and you have to be okay with gear talk being fine but not the point. It would be a small bonus if you are the one who learns post-processing from me, but no big deal.
